notes: The italicised 'the things that' is the supplied antecedent of a headless relative clause and joins the verb's unit under rule 46, not an added unit; the italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
The cognate infinitive absolute אָסֹף takes 'utterly' under rule 56 while the finite verb keeps 'I will consume'.

The second existential fuses with its waw as 'nor' under rule 35, headed on the negative morpheme, since the ASV writes no second presentative frame; the first אֵין keeps the full 'there shall be no' under rule 50.
The dative לְ before 'given them' is unrepresented under rule 40, and the object suffix of יַעַבְרוּם takes the expanded 'from them' headed on the pronoun (rule 18).
